segments.alt: Exclusive Reveal Of A New Mode In Pokémon Ultra Sun And Moon

segments.note: 岩尾和昌是Game Freak的游戏开发者，《宝可梦 究极之日·究极之月》是他首次担任总监的作品。
segments.original: We're ending our stretch of exclusive features covering Pokémon with a video feature showing off Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon in action. While visiting Game Freak, we stopped by the desk of Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon's director Kazumasa Iwao and he showed off the Alola Photo Club. The game marks Iwao's directorial debut, and he has been with Game Freak since the development of Pokémon Black and White. For more information on the new mode before you watch the video, here's how the The Pokémon Company is explaining it...
segments.translation: 我们这组宝可梦独家专题报道的最后一篇，是一段展示《宝可梦 究极之日·究极之月》实机内容的视频。探访 GAME FREAK 时，我们来到游戏总监岩尾和昌的工位前，他向我们展示了阿罗拉摄影俱乐部。这是岩尾首次担任总监；他从《宝可梦 黑·白》开发时期起便在 GAME FREAK 工作。观看视频前，先来看看宝可梦公司对这一新模式的介绍。

segments.original: At the Alola Photo Club, you can take pictures with your Pokémon. You can choose from a variety of poses for yourself and your Pokémon and also freely control the composition of the shot, including the angle, and position of the subjects in the scene. By taking pictures with your Pokémon, you can deepen your friendship even more! After you’ve taken your picture, you can decorate the shot with various stamps and frames and share the finished result with other players using the communication features of the game.
segments.translation: 在阿罗拉摄影俱乐部，你可以和自己的宝可梦一起拍照。你可以为自己和宝可梦选择多种姿势，还能自由控制拍摄的构图，包括角度以及拍摄对象在画面中的位置。和宝可梦一起拍照，能让你们的友谊更加深厚！拍完照片后，你可以用各种贴纸和相框来装饰照片，并利用游戏的通信功能，把完成的作品分享给其他玩家。
